lead.event: MNC Sky Vision receives a PKPU petition from Ascot Group
lead.headline: MSKY faces Ascot Group PKPU petition over USD4 million claim
lead.blurb: The Central Jakarta Commercial Court granted MNC Sky Vision temporary PKPU status on 5 November for 43 calendar days, through 17 December. Ascot Group claims USD4 million, recorded as Rp71.99 billion in trade payables as of 30 September. At that date, MNC Sky Vision had Rp2.11 billion in cash and equivalents against Rp490.52 billion in short-term liabilities. Management plans to meet obligations through operating cash flow under the PKPU peace scheme and has no corporate actions planned in the next 12 months.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Merdeka Battery Materials plans a 10.79-billion-share private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBMA plans private placement of up to 10.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Battery Materials would price shares at no less than 90% of the 25-day average closing price. The issue equals 10% of paid-up capital and could dilute holders by up to 9.09%, with about a quarter of proceeds for working capital and the rest for expansion. Shareholders vote on 8 December, subject to independent approval.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Terregra Asia Energy plans a 21-billion-share private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TGRA plans 21-billion-share private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Terregra Asia Energy plans to issue the shares at Rp10 each to Triple Berkah Bersama, Adidaya Mandiri Sejahtera and Hilal Arkan Energi, which submitted commitment letters on 16 November. The new shares would represent 88.42% of fully paid-up capital and dilute existing shareholders by the same amount. Shareholder approval is planned for 28 December.

earnings_guidance.event: CGS International cuts GoTo's target price and raises its 2026 profit forecast
earnings_guidance.headline: CGS International raises GOTO's 2026 profit forecast to Rp1.4 trillion, cuts target to Rp35
earnings_guidance.blurb: Joanne Ong raised the projection by 180% and lifted her Adjusted EBITDA estimate by 7% to Rp3.5 trillion, while maintaining an Add recommendation for GoTo. The lower sum-of-the-parts valuation reflects a higher Indonesian risk premium after an MSCI warning, lifting the cost-of-equity assumption to 13.3% from 10.9%.

earnings_guidance.event: Indika Energy targets 50% non-coal revenue by 2028 as Awak Mas advances
earnings_guidance.headline: INDY targets 50% non-coal revenue by 2028 as Awak Mas reaches 72.84% complete
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indika's non-coal revenue rose 51.3% year on year to September 2026, lifting its share of gross revenue to 23.1% from 19.2%. Awak Mas was 72.84% complete after US$398 million of its estimated US$568 million cost had been spent. The project targets first commercial production in the first half of 2027 at around 100,000 ounces a year.

earnings_guidance.event: VIVA and MDIA report first-half 2026 financial results
earnings_guidance.headline: VIVA reports Rp60.02 billion H1 2026 profit as MDIA posts Rp32.30 billion loss
earnings_guidance.blurb: Visi Media Asia recorded Rp441.44 billion in revenue and Rp30.68 billion in EBITDA, while Intermedia Capital reported Rp281.82 billion in revenue and Rp59.71 billion in EBITDA. Their H1 2025 results were a Rp1.19 trillion profit and a Rp11.44 billion loss, respectively.
